description_en: Provisions and configures an Internet NAT gateway for a specified AgentTeams instance
description_zh: 为指定AgentTeams实例开通并配置阿里云公网NAT网关
kebab_example: aliyun agentteams configure-nat-gateway --instance-id instanceId --description create_public_nat_gateway_for_agentteams_instance --eip-bandwidth 5 --client-token test --nat-gateway-instance-id nat-xxxx --eip-allocation-id eip-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigureNatGateway

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AgentTeams instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.example: create public nat gateway for agentteams instance
parameters.help_en: The description for the NAT gateway, EIP, and SNAT rule creation
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The bandwidth of the automatically applied EIP. Valid values: 1 to 200. Unit: Mbit/s
parameters.help_zh: **自动申请 EIP 的带宽，范围 1-200**
parameters.name: eip_bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NAT gateway instance
parameters.name: nat_gateway_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The allocation ID of the EIP
parameters.name: eip_allocation_id
